name: Raven macOS design additions
note: Read over tokens.json (raven-core desktop/design, synced by scripts/sync-design.sh). This file may only change colours tokens.json names, never add one. The iPhone app's tokens.ios.json raises the same colours to the same values.

colorContrast.note: Colours of tokens.json raised to the WCAG AA contrast of 4.5 to 1 for body text on background and surface (textTertiary was 3.06 to 1 in light, 3.37 to 1 in dark). The app reads them over tokens.json; raven-core should take them in tokens.json.
